kind: MEMQ-001 directive and supporting design readiness council round 1
instruction: The directives look fine to me, but have the council assess the memQ directive.

review_focus: CD-CMD-MEMQ-001-memory-queries.md and controlling memory-query-command-contract.md; current full edited document set and executable readiness, not implementation conformance.

criteria.MR-01: Authority and exact approved option R scope: policy/intent/board/contract/directive/approval chain, baseline versus candidate, allowed and deferred paths, no inferred acceptance or delivery.
criteria.MR-02: Closed neutral schema/API: MQ-01 thirteen models, six payload alternatives and sixteen additive exports, validation/defaults/exact types/order, MQ-D4 narrow extensions and installed retained-probe plan.
criteria.MR-03: Neutral ownership and invocation: MQ-02 single availability/query, validation/read/await order, exception/cancel identity, arg/kind/graph selection and declared MQ-D1/MQ-D2 refusals.
criteria.MR-04: Current-source compatibility for MQ-03/MQ-04/MQ-05: metrics/records/meta/graph laziness, type/format/concatenation/preview/empty/warning order versus actual legacy code; 76 observations plus four supplemental cases, no double evaluation.
criteria.MR-05: Option R feasibility and complete behavior through existing public APIs: persisted listing grouping/count/order, ingestion/promotion/re-ingestion, malformed metadata/per-collection warning policy and cancellation, fake preservation, no framework or filesystem/source changes.
criteria.MR-06: Chat integration and once-only boundary MQ-07: wrappers/registry ownership, exact typed outcome consumption, pure renderers, custom/renamed handlers, unchanged metadata and 41/3 surface.
criteria.MR-07: Test/mutation/acceptance design: MQ-T01..14 traceability and enforceability, call-phase witnesses/origins, unchanged-control checks, no weakened old assertions, staged D1/D2/D3 review gates.
criteria.MR-08: Executable validation instructions D0..D5: reproducible materialization/captures/comparers, private scratch and guard inputs/caches, test/static/build/install commands, exact actual-artifact/probe identity; source inspection and bounded dry-runs, no demand for future product deliverables.
criteria.MR-09: Evidence integrity and provenance: verify embedded/raw current MEMQ preparation 23 receipts + programs/fixtures/baseline/replay, supplemental four cases and supplemental/controller records as relevant; distinguish independently executed checks from inspected receipts; prior unit verdicts are not correctness proof for this directive.
criteria.MR-10: Candidate isolation/preservation and bounded conclusion: request/manifest/pins/HEAD/branch/index/staging/protected/dirty/ignored exports and supplied evidence identities at start/end, honest baseline debt and residual limits, no product/construction/UAT/acceptance/delivery verdict.

shared_checkout_read_only_exception: All review seats use the frozen shared workdir read-only. Every write/cache/export/copied source/report must be in the reviewer own fresh external scratch, never this controller scratch or supplied builder directories. No checkout, worktree creation, git index writes, board/doc/product changes or cleanup. GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 to every Git child. Hash EXACT git ls-files -s -z logical index BEFORE status at both boundaries. Controller scratch/request/manifest are supplied read-only inputs.

required_now: Verify request hash first, then read request and manifest completely and check hashes/identity at start/end.
Read primary directive and contract fully plus relevant authority/current source and complete bounded candidate diff; no inherited verdicts or private builder reasoning.
Independently verify directive and approval hashes; inspect raw/embedded preparation and supplemental evidence, source/API feasibility and requirement traceability.

Dry-check embedded shell syntax and materialization; independently run comparator selftest and a 76-case original baseline capture/replay on private clean exported committed source using copied programs and pinned private harness; use own cache/output paths.
Run board validate, board render --check, documentation lifecycle and git diff --check through guarded/private paths. No root mutation or sync.
Inspect future D0..D5 commands for feasibility/isolation. Additional bounded synthetic controls allowed in private scratch; all actual commands and limits reported.
not_required_now: MEMQ product implementation or missing future MQ tests/probe/wheels.
Re-running historical root Ruff534, root test_display conflict or registry format debt; do not call baseline debt passing or waived.
Re-running all accepted DIAG/SESSION/pilot validation or all historical embedded/raw pairs unrelated to this directive.

tools.commands: Create own fresh /tmp/memq-directive-review-<seat>-* scratch. Export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; prepare.py YOUR_SCRATCH/prepared --wheelhouse SUPPLIED_WHEELHOUSE (no fetch). Then use YOUR_SCRATCH/prepared/pilot_run.py with distinct labels and rewrite ALL env/cache/basetemp/export/report args. Never replay supplied receipt argv verbatim; explicit --cache-dir must be rewritten too.

known_baseline_debt: Root Ruff 534 findings failed/unwaived; root test_display collection conflict with 6929 collected; legacy registry formatting failed/unwaived.
Original trial-capture is explicitly not the 76-case baseline.
Planning/controller checks and maintainer approval are not independent council validation.
report_requirements: Return exactly one top verdict VERIFIED / CHANGES_REQUESTED / BLOCKED, explicitly scoped to this directive/design readiness only.

Number mandatory findings with stable seat-prefixed IDs (MEMQ-DIR-SOL-001 / MEMQ-DIR-ASTRA-001 / MEMQ-DIR-CLAUDE-001 etc), severity, exact file:line, violated requirement, concrete evidence/risk, minimal mitigation and required verification. Keep advisory suggestions distinct.

Provide all MR-01..10 criterion outcomes and material MQ/T traceability; executed commands versus inspected receipts; integrity/isolation; baseline debt versus regression; residual limits; advisory rubric score out of 10. Scores/majority never override mandatory findings.

Write full report/evidence into YOUR OWN scratch and return its absolute path/hash in final. No PR or GitHub comments/messages. No acceptance, new authority, next-family, implementation, publication or delivery action.
